observations: The sole matrix case still contested at100 was inspected: its last20Cycles contain9naval and3ground attacks,23expansions,9moves and13fleet creations, alongside repairs and resupply. This is active conflict, not an idle controller loop.

The unfinished independent-opponent case was inspected: repeated enemy ground assaults, losses, capital defence and rationing explain the operational faction recovery bottleneck; the other controllers remain distinct opponents, not an optimal-play standard.
The former200Cycle repair-loop case now reaches coalition/control milestones at41/44 under current inputs. Regression tests prevent repaired damage being repeatedly counted as fresh progress.
Independent replacements have mixed outcomes and can win seats their baseline counterpart lost; production controllers are not universally stronger and no losses were discarded.
All12traits occur with all6strategies in all3positions. Free Void expansion now survives the controller reserve check;15focused trait tests supplement the engine regressions.
Larger-map controls at52and68 are descriptive diagnostics, not estimates of average campaign duration.
